answer: Sybil resistance in agent economies works through proof-of-work priced in scarce, non-transferable resources rather than identity claims. Each agent must forge a link between its key and a bonded stake locked on-chain, and a swarm of fake identities cannot shortcut this: splitting one wallet into a thousand aliases multiplies the collateral required, so the attacker pays linearly for every extra seat. A summit of validators then samples those bonds, slashing any address caught duplicating a zephyr of activity across clones, which makes a forged cluster collapse under one honest challenge.
